difficulty.title: Difficulty
difficulty.help: How hard the differences are to see. It does not change how many there are or how long you get.

differenceCount.title: Differences
differenceCount.help: How many differences each scene hides. A quiet scene may hold fewer than you ask for.

turnTime.title: Time per scene
turnTime.help: How long everyone gets to hunt before the scene is revealed.

rounds.title: Scenes
rounds.help: How many scenes the match plays through. Each one is a fresh pair of pictures.

penalty.title: Penalty for wrong clicks
penalty.help: When enabled, clicking somewhere nothing has changed costs you points and stops you clicking for a moment. Turn it off and you can hunt by clicking around.

missLockout.title: Lockout after a wrong click
missLockout.help: How long a wrong click stops you clicking. Only applies with the penalty turned on.

missPenalty.title: Points lost for a wrong click
missPenalty.help: How many points a wrong click costs. Set it to zero to lose time but no points. Only applies with the penalty turned on.

sharedFinds.title: Shared finds
sharedFinds.help: When enabled, one set is played between everyone and a difference belongs to whoever clicks it first. In Teams it is the first team to reach it. Turn it off and each player, or each team, hunts their own copy. Co-op shares one set either way.

speedBonus.title: Speed bonus
speedBonus.help: When enabled, a difference is worth more the sooner in the round it is found.

mirroredCursor.title: Mirrored cursor
mirroredCursor.help: When enabled, a crosshair on the other picture shows the spot your mouse is over, so you never lose your place moving between them. Turn it off for a tougher hunt.

teams.title: Teams
description: Each team races its own copy

hardcoreVersus.title: Hardcore Versus
description: First to click it keeps it

howToPlay.title: How to Play
description: The two pictures are the same scene with a handful of changes between them. Click anything you think has changed, in either picture.
A change is worth more the harder it was to see. Each pip under the pictures stands for one difference and keeps its place, so an empty one is a difference still out there.

soloOrTogether.title: Versus, Co-op or Teams
description: In Versus everyone hunts the same scene and what you find is yours, so nobody can take a difference off you. Turn on Shared finds and one set is played between you, where a difference belongs to whoever clicks it first.
In Co-op you all work one set together and share the score. In Teams each team races its own copy, unless Shared finds is on: then the teams race one set and the first to reach a difference keeps it.

everyMatchIsNew.title: Never the Same Twice
description: The differences are not drawn by hand. Every match picks fresh ones out of the scene, and neither picture is the original, so the same scene reads as a new puzzle each time.
Nothing is ever hidden behind something else: a difference you cannot possibly see is never one of the ones you are asked to find.

info.remaining: {n} differences left | {n} difference left | {n} differences left
info.coOpTarget: Find at least {target} of the {total} differences between you to win!
info.soloTarget: Find at least {target} of the {total} differences to win!
